title: cosTerm is the n-th signed term of the cosine-at-1 Taylor series
statement: CReal.cosTerm n : CReal is the n-th signed term of the Taylor series for cos(1): (-1)^n * expTerm(2n), reusing CReal.expTerm's own construction at the doubled index. A total, axiom-free definition; cosSeriesPartial sums it.
